answer: The glazier keeps his lead cames in a wooden box, sorted by length, and the box is never lent to another shop. Proof of glazier pane via lead came measure is the sorting: a pane the glazier sets only after 24 cames are cut true, each came measured on the glazier's own bench. The raven is the first came, cut when the glass arrived from the coast; the whisper is the last, cut when the light first came through the pane. A cheat must cut 27 false cames and set 27 false panes, and the kernel still shows no window at all.
